# Breathe Getaway

> Guides on studying and job hunting with AI.

## Guides
- [How to study faster with AI (and actually remember it)](https://breathegetaway.ai/study-faster-with-ai/): Use AI to explain, quiz and summarize so you learn faster, without just copying answers. A simple routine for any class.
- [How to apply to more jobs in less time](https://breathegetaway.ai/apply-to-more-jobs-faster/): Practical ways to send more tailored job applications each week: a master resume, fast tailoring, and autofill for long application forms.
- [How to summarize a lecture or YouTube video in minutes](https://breathegetaway.ai/summarize-a-lecture-or-youtube-video/): Get the main points of a long lecture or video fast, then quiz yourself on it. Works for recorded classes, YouTube and online courses.
- [How to make flashcards with AI (Anki and Quizlet)](https://breathegetaway.ai/make-flashcards-with-ai/): Turn notes, slides or a textbook chapter into flashcards in minutes with AI, then review them with spaced repetition so they stick.
- [How to study for finals in less time](https://breathegetaway.ai/how-to-study-for-finals/): A finals plan that works: start a week out, quiz yourself instead of re-reading, space your reviews, and sleep. With AI shortcuts for each step.
- [How to write a cover letter fast (that still sounds like you)](https://breathegetaway.ai/write-a-cover-letter-fast/): A simple three-paragraph cover letter you can tailor in minutes, plus how to use AI without sounding generic.
- [How to fill out Workday job applications faster](https://breathegetaway.ai/fill-out-workday-applications-faster/): Why Workday applications take so long, and practical ways to get through them faster: resume parsing, saved answers and autofill.
- [How to tailor your resume to a job description in 10 minutes](https://breathegetaway.ai/tailor-resume-to-job-description/): A quick method to match your resume to each job posting so it gets past screening and in front of a person.
